definitions: A power tool that can perform heavy-duty drilling and chiselling, often used in construction for drilling into concrete, brick, or stone.
A type of hammer drill that uses an electro-pneumatic hammer mechanism to generate high-impact energy, making it more effective for masonry work than a standard hammer drill.
examples: He used a rotary hammer to break up the old patio.
The construction crew brought a rotary hammer for the foundation work.
A rotary hammer is essential for drilling large holes in concrete.
